_help: What archive-project keeps and what it calls cruft. Edit freely (or ask Claude: 'from now on, keep the .srt files when archiving').
Patterns are matched case-insensitively against paths relative to the project folder, with / as the separator.
'*' matches anything, including across folders. {footage} {audio} {graphics} {drafts} {finals} {work} are replaced by your project_layout folders.

dirs: a folder name anywhere in the path. files: the file name. paths: the whole relative path. files_with_original: only when the original clip (same name without the proxy part) is also in the project.
only: media | video | audio | image | video+image limits a rule to those file kinds. keep_exts: text means text files (recipes, notes, transcripts) never match the rule.
Cruft rules are tried in order; the first match wins. Anything no rule matches is kept. A file a Resolve export (.drp) or an ffmpeg recipe points at is always kept, whatever rule matches it.

cruft.name: os-metadata
cruft.why: Finder / Explorer housekeeping files, recreated automatically

cruft.name: render-cache
cruft.why: DaVinci Resolve render cache; Resolve rebuilds it when needed

cruft.name: optimized-media
cruft.why: Resolve optimized media (lighter copies for smooth playback); regenerate from the originals

cruft.name: proxies
cruft.why: proxy files (small edit-friendly copies); the camera originals stay

cruft.name: aroll-draft-work
cruft.why: a-roll draft intermediates (audio extracts, frames, preview renders); the cut list (.aroll.tb.json) and exports stay

cruft.name: transcription-audio
cruft.why: audio extracted only to transcribe; the transcript stays

cruft.name: drafts
cruft.why: review renders; the timeline or recipe re-renders them. Review notes (.review/notes.json) stay

cruft.name: scratch
cruft.why: rendered bytes in the work folder (frames, segment caches, contact sheets); its text (recipes, plans, notes) stays

cruft.name: unused-media
cruft.why: video and images that no Resolve export and no recipe uses (never-imported takes, test stills). Off unless you opt in; audio never counts
